name: Dead Roads [UPDATE 1]
desc:
In 2019, the world succumbed to a vicious new virus. Known as "Nervo-19", this deadly virus attacks the central nervous system before taking control of the body. 

You and your friends must travel in an armored truck from the Vegas Outpost to the New York 5th Ave—Quarantine Zone where a potential vaccine awaits. The journey is long and dangerous but you must go for what little hope remains... Godspeed.

⭐Like and Favorite our game to stay up to date!

How to play: 
🚚 Drive your armored truck to the final outpost!
💰 Loot the buildings along the way!
🧟 Survive and run from "The Infected"!
🤝 Team up with your friends!

Inspired by: "Dead Rails", "The Last of Us", "The Walking Dead"
